tooltip.youshallnottick.ticking_totem.in: Enables living entity ticking within a radius
youshallnottick.ponder.tag.ticking_compo: Components which help control living entity ticking in the world.
youshallnottick.ponder.ticking_totem.tex: YouShallNotTick is a simple mod which disables unnecessary AI processing of configured living entities far away from players.
The mod only disables AI, movement and collisions of living entities, drastically improving performance.
Processing such as cooldowns and events are still processed as normal, regardless of range.
The Totem of Ticking allows living entities within it's radius to tick like normal, regardless of the distance from players.
It should be noted that the Totem of Ticking is not a chunk loader and will not allow monster spawners to function or act as a fake player.
Sneak clicking on the Totem of Ticking will show the radius in which living entities will function.
The Totem of Ticking can be controlled via redstone.
When powered, the totem is deactivated. It will no longer allow living entities within the radius to tick.
